rationale: This 2009 record by Ulrich van der Heyden is a book review of Andreas Eckert's 2007 historical monograph on African bureaucrats, state order and politics in Tanzania (1920-1970). It is entirely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (failing Criterion 1 and Criterion 4) and is a book review rather than an empirical study or systematic review (failing Criterion 3). Primary exclusion code: E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings result in exclusion: although the reviewed historical volume addresses state administration and bureaucracy generally (plain Criterion 2), the record is a non-empirical book review on general political/administrative history in Tanzania with no connection to water or sanitation service access.
